title: Alternative Computational Formulations for Testing Discrete-Choice Random Utility Models: Half-Space and Network-Flow Formulations
abstract: arXiv:2611.19177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops computational algorithms for testing discrete-choice random utility models (RUM). The set of RUM-consistent choice probabilities forms a polytope, and existing computational methods rely on its vertex representation. We exploit alternative half-space (Block--Marschak inequalities) and network-flow representations to develop two methods based on the alternating direction method of multipliers and a flow-based column-generation algorithm. Compared with current vertex-based methods, our algorithms are better suited to GPU implementation. We establish convergence guarantees and provide optimality certificates for all three algorithms. The resulting algorithms achieve $100$--$600\times$ speedups over existing methods. The solver based on our methods is publicly available on Github at \href{https://github.com/mingxiz/d-rum-testing-gpu}{\texttt{d-rum-testing-gpu}}.

translated_title: 检验离散选择随机效用模型的替代计算表述：半空间与网络流表述
translated_abstract: 本文为检验离散选择随机效用模型（RUM）开发了计算算法。RUM一致的选择概率集合构成一个多面体，现有的计算方法依赖于其顶点表示。我们利用替代的半空间表示（Block-Marschak不等式）和网络流表示，开发了两种基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的方法以及一种基于流的列生成算法。与现有基于顶点的方法相比，我们的算法更适合GPU实现。我们为所有三种算法建立了收敛性保证，并提供了最优性证书。所得算法相比现有方法实现了100至600倍的加速。基于我们方法的求解器已在Github上公开发布：https://github.com/mingxiz/d-rum-testing-gpu。
tldr: 本文提出基于半空间和网络流表示的替代计算表述及相应算法（ADMM与列生成），使离散选择随机效用模型的检验比传统基于顶点的方法快100至600倍，并更适合GPU实现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes alternative half-space and network-flow formulations with ADMM and column-generation algorithms for testing discrete-choice random utility models, achieving 100–600× speedups over vertex-based methods and better GPU suitability.
